resilience.method: Undirected route graph over the 3,388 forecast airports with >=1 route (18,809 edges): union of the (15-partner truncated) `routes` lists in forecasts.json and the full OpenFlights snapshot (data/inputs/routes.dat) restricted to these airports; the 706 airports without any route are excluded. removal_reach_loss_pct = 100 x (pairs of other airports that become disconnected + pairs whose shortest hop path lengthens by >=2) / pairs that were connected before removal. The hop-lengthening term is computed exactly (all-pairs BFS on G minus v) for the top 40 airports by degree; for every other airport only the disconnection term is used (exact, via connected components of G minus v, non-zero only for articulation points; 357 found). removal_disconnected_airports = airports cut off from the largest surviving piece of the airport's component. dependency_hhi = Herfindahl index of the airport's edge shares, share_j = importance_present(partner j) / sum over partners (1.0 = single partner). redundancy_score (0-100) = 100 x [0.5 x min(alt, 6)/6 + 0.5 x percentile rank of 2-hop reach share], where alt = number of neighbours that remain attached to the largest surviving component when the airport is removed (each is an edge-disjoint path into the core) and 2-hop reach share = share of all graph airports within 2 hops. vulnerability_class: fragile if dependency_hhi >= 75th percentile (0.617) and degree <= 3; robust if redundancy_score >= 60th percentile (59.1); otherwise watch. critical_hubs = top 25 by removal_reach_loss_pct; fragile_spokes = airports with degree <= 3 sorted by dependency_hhi (ties by importance_present). Projected network_stats (h5/h10) hold the topology constant: avg_degree and density use edge weights sqrt(level_u/present_u x level_v/present_v) (every present weight = 1), avg_clustering is the mean node clustering coefficient weighted by projected level (plain mean for present), and top_betweenness at every horizon uses path length 1/(score_u x score_v / 1e4) with score = importance_present / level_h5 / level_h10_damped, k=300 sampled sources (seed 42), so the three lists are directly comparable.

scenario.method: Linear surrogate: a standardised Ridge regression (alpha=100, median imputation, the notebook's log1p/clipping transforms) fitted on the production training slice (comparable, non-COVID, high-confidence rows; n=19,923 for h5, n=12,196 for h10) predicting the 5-/10-year importance change from the 46 model features. Each sensitivity is coef / feature std, i.e. d(importance change, points) per unit of the feature, then rescaled to the unit stated in `units` (growth rates are stored as fractions, so x0.01 gives per percentage point; log1p features give per +1% of the raw value). Sensitivities are partial effects holding the other features fixed and are not causal; the 1y/3y/5y horizons of one driver are collinear, so read them jointly via the *_sustained composites (+1pp applied to all horizons of that driver at once). country_shock_examples instead use the shipped non-linear production h5 ensemble (LightGBM + Ridge): +2pp is added to gdp_growth_1y/3y/5y and imf_gdp_growth_pct for every airport of the country and the mean change in the predicted 5-year importance change is reported.

units.imf_gdp_growth_pct: pct points of projected GDP growth
units.gdp_growth_sustained: pct points applied simultaneously to gdp_growth_1y, gdp_growth_3y, gdp_growth_5y, imf_gdp_growth_pct
units.tourism_growth_sustained: pct points applied simultaneously to tourism_growth_1y, tourism_growth_3y, tourism_growth_5y
units.pop_growth_sustained: pct points applied simultaneously to pop_growth_1y, pop_growth_3y, pop_growth_5y
units.traffic_growth_sustained: pct points applied simultaneously to traffic_growth_1y, traffic_growth_3y, traffic_growth_5y

horizon10_shrinkage.note: Persistence (alpha=0) had the lowest MAE; no shrunk ensemble beats it. By the documented rule, best_alpha is the largest alpha whose mean MAE stays within 2% of the persistence MAE (5.317); alpha=0.04 costs +1.5% MAE and keeps the sign of the ensemble change so the +10 map still shows direction. This is a presentation choice, not a validated accuracy gain. MAE averaged over 2 folds (fold1, pseudo_fold_early).
